title: keetia mannii
intro: Keetia mannii, commonly known as African prince, is a medicinal plant species native to tropical Africa. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and aid in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Keetia mannii include its antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Keetia mannii are responsible for its therapeutic effects and have been shown to have antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
